module: MQTT client (3.1.1 or 5.0) from the luamqtt library. Handles connecting to a broker through a connector (luasocket by default), sending/receiving packets, publish/subscribe/unsubscribe, QoS 1 and 2 acknowledgements, keep_alive (PINGREQ), automatic reconnection and user events registered with on(). The client is driven either by an ioloop (ioloop.lua), or synchronously (mqtt.run_sync).
usage:
local client = require('libs/luamqtt/mqtt/client')
local cl = client.create({uri = 'broker.local:1883', clean = true, id = 'beamng'})
cl:on('message', function(msg, c) print(msg.topic, msg.payload) end)
cl:on('connect', function(pkt, c) c:subscribe({topic = 'test/#'}) end)
require('libs/luamqtt/mqtt/ioloop').get():add(cl); cl:start_connecting()
notes: Events accepted by on(): connect, subscribe, unsubscribe, message, acknowledge, error, close, auth. Any other name raises an error.

Handler signatures: connect(packet, client), subscribe(packet, client), unsubscribe(packet, client), message(packet, client), acknowledge(packet, client), auth(packet, client), error(err, client[, packet]), close(conn, client).

Creation arguments (allowed keys only): uri, clean (required), version (4 or 5), id, username, password, secure, will, keep_alive (default 60 s), properties, user_properties, reconnect, connector, ssl_module. An unknown key raises an error.
If no id is provided, a random identifier 'luamqtt-v<version>-<hex>' is generated.
Network error functions return false and a message; arguments of the wrong type raise an exception.

create.desc: Creates, initializes and returns an MQTT client instance. If a default ioloop already exists and is running, the client is added to it and the connection starts.

client_mt.desc: MQTT client instance returned by create. Notable fields: args (validated arguments), handlers (callbacks per event), connection (connection table, nil if disconnected).

__init.desc: Validates the creation arguments (uri 'host[:port]', clean, version 4/5, id, username, password, secure, will{topic,payload,qos,retain}, keep_alive, reconnect, connector, ssl_module, properties, user_properties) and initializes the handlers.

on.desc: Adds event handlers: on(name, function) or on({name1 = f1, name2 = f2}). Raises an error if the event name is invalid.

off.desc: Removes a handler from an event.

subscribe.desc: Subscribes to a topic. Returns the SUBSCRIBE packet identifier; the callback is called when the subscription is confirmed.

args.desc: topic, qos (default 0), no_local / retain_as_published / retain_handling / properties / user_properties (MQTT 5 only), callback.

returns.desc: Packet identifier, or false and error message.

unsubscribe.desc: Unsubscribes from a topic; callback called when the broker confirms.

returns.desc: Packet identifier, or false and message.

args.desc: topic, payload, qos (default 0), retain (default false), dup (default false), properties, user_properties, callback (called on acknowledgement).

returns.desc: true or packet identifier; false and message on failure.

acknowledge.desc: Acknowledges a received PUBLISH message (PUBACK, or PUBREC for QoS 2).

disconnect.desc: Sends DISCONNECT to the broker then closes the connection.

close_connection.desc: Immediately closes the network connection, without DISCONNECT. Fires the close event; may schedule a reconnection if reconnect is active.

start_connecting.desc: Starts the connection to the broker (network open then CONNECT).

open_connection.desc: Opens the network connection to the broker via the connector.

send_connect.desc: Sends the CONNECT packet on the open connection.

set_ioloop.desc: Associates or dissociates (nil) the client with an ioloop; called by ioloop:add/remove.

acknowledge_pubrel.desc: Sends PUBREL (second phase of a QoS 2 exchange).

acknowledge_pubcomp.desc: Sends PUBCOMP (last phase of a QoS 2 exchange).

handle.desc: Calls the handlers registered for an event.

_apply_network_timeout.desc: Applies the ioloop's network timeout to an already established connection.

_apply_secure.desc: Builds conn.secure_params from the creation arguments.

_io_iteration.desc: Performs one I/O iteration: receiving the next packet and firing the events.

_ioloop_iteration.desc: One I/O iteration called by the ioloop.

_sync_iteration.desc: One I/O iteration called by the synchronous loop (mqtt.run_sync).

_parse_uri.desc: Fills conn.host and conn.port from args.uri (port 1883, or 8883 when secure).

_receive_packet.desc: Receives a packet from the connection.

_send_packet.desc: Sends a packet on the connection.
